data = defaultdict(list)

    r = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(r)
    for row in r:
        if row[0] in ("49a712e6-9bdb-50ff-bf2e-5573d582bffc", "b3f73bc4-684f-5295-a07e-c26b2b13702c"):
            ts = row[1]
            v = row[2]
            if ts.startswith("2018-01-24"):
                h = int(ts.split("T")[1][0:2]) if "T" in ts else int(ts.split(" ")[1][0:2])
                if 8 <= h <= 18:
                    data[row[0]].append((ts, float(v)))

peri = data["49a712e6-9bdb-50ff-bf2e-5573d582bffc"]
dc = data["b3f73bc4-684f-5295-a07e-c26b2b13702c"]
